explanation: Holding hands, hugging, or a brief kiss between couples is normal and accepted in German public life, but Germans are generally more reserved than Mediterranean cultures and view prolonged or intense displays as inappropriate, especially in professional settings. Workplaces in particular expect a clear line between affection and professional conduct.
local_tip: Keep physical affection brief and low-key in public, and avoid it altogether at work or in business settings.

also_check.note: Public displays of affection are discouraged and can embarrass onlookers in most everyday settings.
Kissing as a greeting and moderate affection between couples in public are common and socially accepted.
Public affection between unmarried couples is culturally and legally unacceptable.
